rule: Eligible means a CodexBar provider has a reviewed OpenCode V2 catalog model-provider counterpart, not that its acquisition strategy works with an existing OpenCode credential. Excluded means a distinct external account/product or an acquisition surface unrelated to OpenCode-supported accounts. Unresolved means plausible alias without a verified account/pool mapping and is not a target gap yet. Strategy IDs are normalized acquisition routes in parity.json, not upstream symbol names.
